categories.main_business_segments: Xiamen Changelight Co., Ltd. is a leading LED chip and compound semiconductor manufacturer. The company's primary business segments include LED epitaxial wafers and chips (accounting for 73.17% of revenue), and other semiconductor products. The company manufactures full-color spectrum LED chips from ultraviolet to infrared, gallium arsenide solar cell epitaxial wafers, Mini LED, Micro LED, and VCSEL laser products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies in MOCVD (Metal-Organic Chemical Vapor Deposition) epitaxial growth and LED chip fabrication processes. Key technologies include advanced epitaxial structure design, flip-chip technology, high-density passivation layer deposition, and precision photolithography. The company employs both conventional and flip-chip manufacturing structures with comprehensive quality control systems meeting ISO9001 and IATF16949 standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves LED packaging enterprises, display manufacturers, lighting companies, automotive suppliers, and consumer electronics manufacturers. Primary end markets include LED display screens (RGB direct display and Mini LED display), general illumination, automotive lighting, backlighting for displays, plant growth lighting, and infrared security applications. The top five customers account for 45.42% of revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with manufacturing facilities in Xiamen (headquarters), Yangzhou, and Nanchang (Jiangxi). Domestic sales represent 98.97% of revenue. The company has established regional offices in the Yangtze River Delta and Pearl River Delta regions to serve customers. International operations account for only 1.03% of revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the LED industry supply chain, positioned as a materials and components supplier. It manufactures epitaxial wafers and chips that are sold to downstream LED packaging and module manufacturers, who then supply to system integrators and end-product manufacturers in display and lighting applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is on high-end product development and operational efficiency improvement. R&D priorities include Mini/Micro LED technology advancement, high-efficiency lighting chips, automotive-grade LED products, plant growth lighting, VCSEL laser chips, and next-generation display technologies. The company invested 138.57 million yuan in R&D (5.80% of revenue) and obtained 45 invention patents and 33 utility model patents in 2023.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of LED chips and epitaxial wafers to downstream packaging and manufacturing companies. Revenue is recognized when products are delivered and accepted by customers. The company employs a direct sales model with dedicated sales teams serving domestic and international markets, supported by technical service and customer support functions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include San'an Optoelectronics, Jucai Optoelectronics, and Huacan Optoelectronics. The company is positioned as a leading domestic LED chip manufacturer with particular strength in RGB display chips, where it maintains industry-leading market share. The company ranks in the first tier of domestic LED chip producers by production capacity and is recognized for product quality and reliability.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized semiconductor manufacturer with 2023 revenue of 2.387 billion yuan, representing 40.63% growth from 2022. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 31.61 million yuan (compared to a loss of 50.35 million yuan in 2022). Total assets reached 6.608 billion yuan. The company achieved profitability recovery in 2023 after losses in 2022, demonstrating improved operational efficiency and market recovery.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through superior product performance in uniformity, consistency, and reliability. Key competitive advantages include leading-edge epitaxial and chip manufacturing technology, comprehensive product portfolio spanning ultraviolet to infrared wavelengths, automotive-grade quality certifications (IATF16949), and strong customer relationships with major display and lighting manufacturers. The company emphasizes high-efficiency products, advanced manufacturing processes, and responsive customer service.
